summary: Carry current main routing and raw CPU kit gate into OMP child transcript tabs

replay.detail: The merge does not change stored transcript content or replay behavior.

schema.detail: No additional schema or generated client contract changes are introduced by this merge.

rules.detail: No additional claim rules or digest changes are introduced.

compatibility.detail: Includes main's routing-parent child IDs; web tabs retain and forward server-provided conversation IDs unchanged. Gateways and owners must run the same child ID encoding.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal upgrade.

manual.detail: Upgrade gateways and owners together and reopen parent conversations to regenerate child links, as required by main's routing change.

recovery.detail: No persisted data recovery is required. Reopen parent conversations to regenerate volatile child links after upgrade or rollback.
